LanguageData.FB_ForcedFleshConversion_Desc: Carry a living prisoner or downed hostile to a colony heart or lunar nerve node. Fingerspikes implant themselves into the target; one is required for every 300 market value. Unrecruitable targets are remade as toughspikes.\n\nA free colonist can accept the flesh willingly: they walk to the heart themselves and stand there while the fingerspikes burrow in, with no anesthetic and no carrier. Your own people need half as many fingerspikes.
